InstructureCon 2027: Cleveland, here we come!

Cleveland, Ohio | July 20, 2027

Explore InstructureCon 2027

Welcome to the most-visited education website in the world.

We love numbers here at Instructure, and it just so happens they love us back. Here are a few of our favorites:

0+

customers

We have customers all over the globe—in over 100 countries, in fact.

0M+

unique visitors annually

Instructure hosts the world's largest online community of educators and edtechnologists.

#0

LMS in the world

Yes, we make Canvas—the LMS that's simple to use, easy to love, and built for a lifetime of learning.

0B

assessment scores created via Mastery

That's a whole lot of formative, predictive, and college prep work.

0K

K–12 schools love Parchment

It's the preferred platform for enrollment, records management, and credentialing.

Solutions for every age, stage, and transitional moment

K–12

A lot changes between that K and that 12. Our ecosystem supports every student, in any learning environment.

See how
Higher education

Our solutions keep educators at the forefront of modern teaching and learning, helping them ensure student success in a changing world.

See how
Business and government

The best places to work prioritize learning and growth. And our tools make it more intuitive, engaging, and effective.

See how

Explore the Instructure ecosystem

Our capabilities, partner network, services, and community are here to help you create your ideal edtech environment and deliver on important outcomes.

Take a look

We're dreaming big, so you can, too.

We love our customers (and the feeling is mutual)

I say this to anyone who asks: It was the best third-party implementation we’ve ever had. Period. I can’t believe how much impact Parchment Data Automation has had.
Molly McDermott-Fallon
Assistant Vice Provost & University Registrar, University of Cincinnati
We needed a way to back up and secure our course content and data–and that's what we got. With Canvas Archiving powered by K16 Solutions, we can secure our student data, stay compliant, and remain in good standing for accreditation purposes.
Sam Kelly
LMS & Senior Systems Administrator at Seminole State College of Florida
The results are so immediate. Teachers can use the data immediately to determine the next instructional steps and whether it's Tier One instruction or what they need to do for specific students at a more tiered level of support.
Claudia Avery
Deputy Superintendent, Fairfield County Schools
By moving to Canvas, we knew we were setting ourselves up for the future. We pride ourselves on being an innovative school. We needed a platform that could match us, that could grow with us.
Josh Blumberg
Director of Academic Tech, Champlain College
